chunks: Hadith 2475 — The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Those who spend their wealth by night and by day, secretly and openly, shall have their reward with their Lord, and no fear shall be upon them, nor shall they grieve."
He صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: "It was revealed concerning spending on horses."

key_terms.يُنْفِقُونَ: they spend or give wealth in the way being praised

ai.seo_question: What was the verse "Those who spend their wealth by night and by day" revealed about?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the verse praising those who spend their wealth secretly and openly was revealed concerning expenditure on horses. It highlights the virtue and reward of such spending within the context indicated by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2475 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said regarding the verse of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious:
"Those who spend their wealth in the night and the day, secretly and openly, they shall have their reward with their Lord (azj), and they shall not fear nor grieve." (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:274)
Prophet (sw) said: "It was revealed concerning spending on horses."
